description: Records one fact about an entity directly; the memory settles it against the facts it holds (INSERTED / SUPERSEDED / COMPETING). Most facts arrive through ingestion.

conversationId.description: Conversation the fact was observed in; marks it grounded

evidence.description: Up to 10 pointers to observations behind the claim; marks it grounded

ref.description: The pointer itself — id, URL, path, sha…

expectedUntil.description: When a temporary state with no stated end (ill, away) should be over; not an end: the fact stays current

userId.description: Per-user scope: the fact (and a vertical+id entity) belongs to this user only

name: record_fact
title: Record a fact about an entity
